text:
lena: Heads-up — after last night's KMS key rotation we saw a spike in SSO errors and an unexpected SCIM deprovisioning wave for a handful of service accounts. :warning:

samir: Ugh, details? Which key/alias was rotated and was there any rewrap/backfill?

lena: Rotated alias `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/idp/cryptoKeys/extid-v3`. No automated rewrap ran because the provisioner failed to fetch new DEK for some envelopes. Audit log snippet: `scim-deprov: user=svc-dataflow extId=null reason=decrypt_error`

samir: Can you paste the IDP log around assertion processing? Also thrown error from the KMS client?

lena: Small paste: ```ERROR idp.processor - EncryptedAttribute decryption failed: java.security.InvalidKeyException: Unsupported padding: RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-256AndMGF1Padding```

idp-bot: Metadata refresh completed for idp:corporate-okta at 03:12 UTC (automated).

ashley: That padding string implies some envelopes were created with OAEP-SHA256 but the runtime attempted OAEP-SHA1 during unwrap. Did the key policy or client default change?

nate: Also worth checking the envelope format we store in provisioning queue. Old envelopes might be `RSA1_5` or `OAEP-SHA1`. If the rewrap job assumed a different algorithm it would produce DEKs that the service can't decrypt.

lena: Confirmed: previous rotation (v2) issued RSAES-OAEP with SHA1 while v3 set OAEP-SHA256. The provisioner binary (v1.4.2) only negotiates OAEP-SHA1.

samir: Oof. Two parts to fix: 1) stop further deprovs by pausing the SCIM worker; 2) either re-add old alias or run a compatibility rewrap that emits OAEP-SHA1-wrapped envelopes for the older clients.

lena: Paused SCIM worker at 03:24 UTC. I re-attached the previous alias as a temp measure and queued a rewrap job for the affected envelopes. That reduced deprovision events. :thumbsup:

ashley: Can we avoid alias reattach in future? We should update rotation runbook: ensure provisioner binary supports algorithm negotiation or we do rolling client upgrades before key algorithm changes.

nate: Agreed. Also add an audit alert for any `extId=null` deprov events so we catch mass deprovs faster. Right now it was detected only via user reports.

lisa: I'll file an incident follow-up and add runbook action items: - compatibility check step - rewrap backfill launch checklist - audit alert rule.

deploy-bot: rollback deployed to provisioner v1.4.3-rollback at 03:54 UTC (trigger: eng-security).

lena: Mitigation complete for now. We'll do a retro and a vuln-triage entry for the poor key-policy test coverage.

samir: Add me to the retro. We should include security oncall and infra to review KMS client defaults and library pinning.

lisa: Adding security-oncall, infra-eng, and devex to the postmortem invite. ETA for report: EOD tomorrow.

lena: Thanks all. Quick checklist for follow-up: backfill success metrics, audit alert live, runbook updated, and a release that ensures explicit OAEP param declaration.

nate: Suggestion: add unit test that simulates rotation with mixed-envelopes + a smoke that verifies SCIM provisioning can decrypt a sample envelope.

ashley: Yep. I'll take the runbook + test story.

lena: Closing thread; will post PM with links to incident doc and logs. :white_check_mark:
